name: nextbillion-mcp
description: Geocoding, place search, routing, distance matrices, isochrones and static maps from NextBillion.ai.
long_description:
Gives Claude 16 read-only tools over NextBillion.ai's location APIs: forward, reverse, batch and structured geocoding, postcode lookup, place search, browse and lookup, autosuggest and autocomplete, directions (car, truck, bike, walk) with avoidance and truck options, distance matrix, isochrones, search along a route, and static map images with markers, lines and polygons.

Requires a NextBillion.ai API key (create one at https://console.nextbillion.ai). Tool arguments are sent to api.nextbillion.io only; nothing is stored locally and no telemetry is collected.

tools.name: autocomplete
tools.description: Complete a partial address into full addresses as the user types.

tools.name: autosuggest
tools.description: Suggest addresses and places from an incomplete or misspelled query.

tools.name: directions
tools.description: Calculate a route between two points, with waypoints, truck and avoidance options.

tools.name: distance_matrix
tools.description: Travel distance and duration for every origin-destination pair in one call.

tools.name: geocode_batch
tools.description: Forward-geocode up to 100 free-text addresses in one request.

tools.name: geocode_forward
tools.description: Convert an address or place name into coordinates and a full postal address.

tools.name: geocode_reverse
tools.description: Find the nearest address for a coordinate.

tools.name: geocode_structured
tools.description: Geocode an address given as separate fields such as street, city and postal code.

tools.name: isochrone
tools.description: Compute the area reachable from a point within given travel times or distances.

tools.name: place_browse
tools.description: List places of given categories around a location, ranked by distance.

tools.name: place_lookup
tools.description: Fetch the full details of a place by its id.

tools.name: place_search
tools.description: Search points of interest and businesses with a free-text query.

tools.name: postcode_lookup
tools.description: Look up a postal code's centroid and boundary, or the postal code containing a coordinate.

tools.name: search_along_route
tools.description: Find places matching a query along a driving route, with the detour each stop adds.

tools.name: static_map_image
tools.description: Render a static map image centered on a location, with markers, lines and polygons.

tools.name: static_route_map
tools.description: Render a static map auto-fitted to a route and/or line and polygon overlays.

nbai_api_key.title: NextBillion.ai API key
nbai_api_key.description: Create a key at https://console.nextbillion.ai. It is sent only to api.nextbillion.io and is never written to disk.
